name: StoredProcedureTest
summary: Tests logic that lives in the database rather than in the application, so that what the schema computes is covered like anything else.

roles.name: StoredProcedureTest
roles.summary: A test whose system under test is a stored procedure. Annotating it says the coverage exists somewhere a code-coverage tool will never look: logic in the database is invisible to every measurement the application makes of itself, so an unannotated procedure and an untested one are indistinguishable.
